name: dittoduo
description: Read-only, redacted access to recent clipboard history from the DittoDuo Mac app (Pro).
long_description: A small launcher, not a server. It finds the MCP helper inside the installed DittoDuo app (/Applications/DittoDuo.app), checks that the helper is signed by DittoDuo's Developer ID, runs it, and checks the running helper again before passing it any input. Requires DittoDuo on macOS. Tool calls need a DittoDuo Pro license and MCP access turned on in DittoDuo Settings; without them the helper answers every call with a short refusal.

tools.name: list_clips
tools.description: List recent clips, newest first: metadata and a short redacted preview, never the full text. Optional kind filter: text, image, mixed or fileRef.

tools.name: get_clip
tools.description: Fetch one recent clip by id: metadata by default, optionally the redacted text.
